A grand old dame - with incredible food.

Phat was our server and he made sure our night was extra special - we were celebrating a birthday and it was made very special by the little touches such as table decorations and incredible service.Thank you Phat :) If I could give a 10++ I would!
The restaurant itself is absolutely stunning, on the veranda of an old colonial building looking over manicure lawns that stretch out to the beach.
We look forward to our return.
